market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $50,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC at ~$82,300; $50,000 implies ~39% drawdown over ~7.5 months. Major bear-case event needed. Historical full-year max drawdowns of ~40% from current levels happen in ~15-20% of years; pricing this seems reasonable. Long horizon adds uncertainty.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Long horizon — macro shocks, regulatory events, or crypto-specific shocks could all trigger; equally, bull continuation.
